assessment: In this study, the authors use high-speed and high-resolution imaging to investigate the role of the yeast syntaxin homolog Tlg2p in endocytic vesicle sorting. They obtain compelling data to show that the Tlg2p-residing compartment within the trans-Golgi network functions as an early/sorting compartment, where endocytic cargos are sorted to either the recycling pathway or the endo-lysosomal pathway. The authors also describe additional molecular details of this sorting process and overall provide important insights into the mechanism of endocytic vesicle sorting in budding yeast.
